feedback: Based on prior experience with similar sensor layouts and wheel configurations, the controller compensates for the moderate sensor size and spacing by emphasizing outer sensors to detect line edges effectively. If the next race shows frequent line loss events, consider increasing sensor size or adjusting sensor positions to cover more of the tape edges. If steering oscillation is high, reduce kp or kd gains or adjust sensor weights to smooth control. If progress is low but line loss is minimal, consider increasing base_speed or tuning integral gain to reduce steady-state error.
requested_changes: sensor_size to 0.016 to improve line coverage if line loss events are high, based on prior evidence that larger sensors reduce line loss.
adjust sensor_positions y-coordinates forward by +0.01 m to improve early line detection if steering oscillation is low but progress is poor.
reduce kp from 10 to 7 if steering oscillation is high, as seen in earlier races with aggressive proportional control.
